info.description: Technologies: the Tech Stack section, the Technologies filter and the tech list on services

description.description: One or two lines explaining what the technology is used for. Shown next to the name in a Tech Stack section.

image.description: Logo or screenshot revealed when the row is hovered in a Tech Stack section. Use a transparent PNG or SVG.

link.description: Full URL the row opens (e.g. https://react.dev). Leave empty for a row that is not clickable — technologies have no page on this site of their own.

services.description: Services that use this technology. This is the same link as 'Tech stack' on each service — filling it in here also adds the technology there, and vice versa.

caseStudies.description: Case studies that used this technology. The same link as 'Tech stack' on each case study. Drives the Technologies filter and the tags shown on case cards.
